title: Naalayak
description: Hailing from Chandigarh, Naalayak is an indie-rock powerhouse led by frontman Sahil Samuel, celebrated across the country for blending the raw grit of rock with soulful Hindi-Urdu poetry. Over the last decade, they have carved out a fierce following through strictly original music and deeply personal anthems like Zakir, Baawra, and tracks from their album Marammat. Known for a voice that breaks, burns, and rises in the same breath, their lyrics cut straight to the bone, turning themes of heartbreak, chaos, and healing into unforgettable live moments. Paired with October’s electric nightlife atmosphere, the evening promises heavy guitar riffs, booming drums, and hundreds of voices screaming every word back at the stage. Whether you’re nursing a heartbreak, chasing an adrenaline rush, or just looking to lose your voice with friends over great food and drinks, this is the kind of raw, unfiltered indie night Dehradun talks about long after the last chord fades.

title: Arz Kiya Hai
description: Some feelings are too deep for conversations, some stories too personal to tell, and some emotions find their way out only through poetry. Arz Kiya Hai , by Mukul Sharma, is an intimate poetry and storytelling experience that brings to life the emotions we all carry within us. Through heartfelt poetry, relatable stories, wit and reflections on everyday life, Mukul take you on a journey through love, heartbreak, relationships, nostalgia and the beautiful complexities of being human. A show that make you smile, takes you back to memories your thought you had forgotten, and perhaps leaves you with a few words that fell like they were written just for you. Whether it`s the laughter of a familiar moment, the ache of an unfinished story, or the comfort of knowing someone else feels the same, Arz Kiya Hai is an evening where words connect hearts and emotions find their voice. Come experience poetry beyond the page - live , heartfelt and unforgettable.

title: Lakhwinder Wadali India Tour - Dehradun
description: Experience the timeless magic of Sufi music with Heritage of Sufism – India Tour, a soulful musical journey celebrating the rich heritage, poetry, and spiritual essence of Sufism. This extraordinary evening features the mesmerizing Lakhwinder Wadali, bringing his powerful voice and the legendary Wadali tradition to your city. From soulful Sufi melodies to powerful Punjabi folk and traditional compositions, the evening promises an immersive experience filled with devotion, emotion, and music. Heritage of Sufism is more than just a concert—it is a journey into the heart of Sufi culture, where every melody tells a story and every verse connects the soul. Come witness an unforgettable night where music meets spirituality, and tradition meets the modern soul.
